zh.title: 中華航空9月22日起調漲國際線訂位服務費至33美元
zh.summary: 中華航空宣布22日起國際線訂位服務費調漲至33美元，國內同業亦陸續調整。
body: 中華航空股份有限公司於9月10日宣布，自9月22日起調整國際線機票訂位服務費，每張由原先的30美元（約新台幣944元）調漲至33美元（約新台幣1039元）。華航表示，相關調整係參考業界標準與市場機制。
機票訂位服務係透過全球分銷系統（GDS）運作，國內航空公司均依使用者付費原則隨票收取訂位服務費。華航今年3月與7月亦曾調漲該項費用。
其餘國籍航空亦陸續調整費用：台灣虎航自9月1日起，非旺季航班每人每航段調至新台幣350元，旺季調至450元；長榮航空與立榮航空自8月起針對行程起始地非菲律賓或香港者每張收取33美元；星宇航空預計於10月7日起調漲至33美元。

en.title: China Airlines to Raise International Booking Fee to $33 on September 22
en.summary: China Airlines will raise its international booking service fee to $33 starting September 22.
body: China Airlines announced on September 10 that it will increase its international booking service fee from $30 (approximately NT$944) to $33 (approximately NT$1,039) per ticket, effective September 22. The airline stated that the adjustment reflects industry standards and market conditions.

Airline ticketing is provided through Global Distribution Systems (GDS), with carriers applying booking service fees under a user-pays principle. China Airlines previously raised this fee in March and July.

Other Taiwanese carriers have also updated their fees: Tigerair Taiwan adjusted off-peak fees to NT$350 and peak fees to NT$450 per passenger segment on September 1. EVA Air and Uni Air began charging $33 per ticket in August for itineraries originating outside the Philippines and Hong Kong, while STARLUX Airlines plans to implement a $33 fee on October 7.

zh.title: 荷蘭與瑞典簽署意向書擬採購薩博GlobalEye預警機
zh.summary: 荷蘭與瑞典簽署意向書擬採購預警機，組員預計將自2028年起共用機隊。
body: 荷蘭國防部與瑞典國防廠商薩博（Saab）於2026年9月10日宣布，荷蘭已與瑞典簽署一項意向書，計劃採購一架薩博GlobalEye空中預警管制機（AEW&C）。荷蘭國防部預計該架預警機將於2031年交付，不過雙方目前尚未簽署正式合約，薩博也表示截至發表聲明為止，尚未收到來自荷蘭的正式訂單。
為了建立操作經驗，荷蘭的空勤與任務人員預計將自2028年起，提前接觸並使用瑞典現有的GlobalEye預警機機隊，這比荷蘭預計接收自身飛機的時間提早了三年。荷蘭國防部指出，這項安排將使操作人員能夠及早熟悉該型飛機及其作業程序，並讓荷蘭得以自2028年起就將該系統投入實際的軍事任務與行動中。
未來這架荷蘭自有的GlobalEye預警機，將與瑞典現有的三架同型預警機共同納入一個聯合機隊共享池中。這項高度合作的機制將允許荷蘭與瑞典的任務組員，根據兩國實際的飛機可用狀況，靈活調用與操作共享池內的任何一架飛機。此外，這兩個國家還計劃在未來針對該預警管制系統的後續研發與系統改進展開密切且長期的技術合作。
荷蘭目前並未擁有專屬的國家預警機隊，部分任務依賴北約現役且已被評為過時的波音E-3A空中預警機（AWACS）。除了此次的獨立採購計畫外，荷蘭與瑞典也是北約十一國盟軍的一部分，該聯盟於2026年7月7日在土耳其安卡拉舉行的峰會上宣布，將共同採購GlobalEye作為北約未來的新一代空中預警機。

en.title: Netherlands signs letter of intent to acquire Saab GlobalEye AEW&C aircraft
en.summary: The Netherlands signs a letter of intent with Sweden to acquire a Saab GlobalEye aircraft.
body: The Netherlands has signed a letter of intent with Sweden to acquire one Saab GlobalEye airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft, as announced by the Dutch Ministry of Defense and Saab on September 10, 2026. The ministry expects the aircraft to be delivered in 2031. However, no formal contract has been signed, and Saab stated it has not yet received an official order.

To facilitate a smooth transition, Dutch flight and mission crews are scheduled to gain access to Sweden's existing GlobalEye fleet starting in 2028, three years before the Netherlands receives its own aircraft. According to the Dutch Ministry of Defense, this early access will allow crews to build valuable operational experience with the aircraft and establish mission procedures, enabling the Netherlands to utilize the system operationally from that point.

The planned Dutch GlobalEye will be integrated into a joint operational pool alongside Sweden's three GlobalEye aircraft. This cooperative pooling arrangement will grant both Dutch and Swedish crews access to whichever aircraft are available. Furthermore, the two nations plan to work together and collaborate on the future development and system upgrades of the airborne early warning and control system.

Currently, the Netherlands lacks a national airborne early warning capability and relies on NATO's aging fleet of Boeing E-3A Sentry aircraft. In addition to this independent acquisition, the Netherlands and Sweden are part of a group of eleven NATO allies that announced on July 7, 2026, during the summit in Ankara, Turkey, a joint effort to procure GlobalEye as the alliance's future AWACS replacement.

zh.title: 聯合航空取消波音777九一一紀念衝場飛行計畫
zh.summary: 聯合航空取消波音777紀念衝場；原訂配合UA175致敬；飛行計畫確定不執行。
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）已取消原訂以波音777（Boeing 777）型客機執行的九一一紀念衝場飛行計畫。該項紀念飛行的時間安排，原本特別規劃配合當年UA175號班機（Flight UA175）發生撞擊的確切時刻進行。
根據 Simple Flying 的報導，聯合航空針對九一一悼念活動所準備的波音777衝場飛行方案最終未能順利實施。這項旨在紀念UA175號班機的致敬衝場飛行，目前已確定取消辦理。

en.title: United Airlines Cancels Planned Boeing 777 9/11 Commemorative Flyover
en.summary: United Airlines cancels planned Boeing 777 flyover; tribute was timed for UA175 moment of impact.
body: United Airlines has canceled a planned commemorative flyover involving a Boeing 777 aircraft that was originally scheduled to mark the anniversary of September 11. The memorial flight had been specifically timed by the carrier to align with the exact moment of impact of Flight UA175.

According to reporting by Simple Flying, the airline's planned schedule for the Boeing 777 commemorative flyover ultimately fell through before it could take place. The tribute event was intended to honor the legacy of Flight UA175, but United Airlines has now called off the planned flight operation.

zh.title: 美軍多架軍機在約旦基地遭伊朗飛彈襲擊受損
zh.summary: 美軍一架A-10及數架F-15在約旦遭飛彈襲擊受損；約旦稱攔截多枚飛彈。
body: 根據媒體報導，美軍多架軍機於2026年9月8日至9日夜間，在約旦的穆瓦法克薩爾蒂空軍基地（Muwaffaq Salti Air Base）遭遇伊朗彈道飛彈襲擊而受損。
《CBS News》與《Air & Space Forces Magazine》指出，一架A-10雷霆二式攻擊機因襲擊導致機翼嚴重受損，另有約八架F-15E打擊鷹式戰鬥機受到輕微損傷，但仍維持可出勤狀態。
約旦武裝部隊發言人表示，防空系統成功攔截20枚彈道飛彈中的18枚，其餘2枚落入無人區，並未造成人員傷亡。該聲明未提及空軍基地或軍機受損情形。美國中央司令部則未對此發表評論。

en.title: US Air Force A-10 and F-15 Fighter Jets Reportedly Damaged in Jordan Missile Strike
en.summary: US A-10 and F-15 aircraft were reportedly damaged in an Iranian ballistic missile attack in Jordan.
body: According to media reports, multiple US Air Force aircraft were damaged in an Iranian ballistic missile attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan overnight on September 8 and 9, 2026.

CBS News and Air & Space Forces Magazine reported that one A-10 Thunderbolt II suffered severe wing damage, while approximately eight F-15E Strike Eagles sustained light damage and remained serviceable.

A Jordan Armed Forces spokesperson stated that air defenses engaged 20 ballistic missiles, destroying 18, with no casualties recorded. The statement did not mention any air base or aircraft damage. The US Central Command did not respond to requests for comment.

zh.title: 行政院研議無人載具條例副署案　預計9月11日對外說明
zh.summary: 行政院研議無人載具法案副署；預計9月11日定調；相關審議已入最後階段
body: 立法院通過之「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」已送至行政院，預計行政院最晚將於2026年9月11日定調是否副署。行政院發言人李慧芝表示，針對該條例之法條與執行面審議已處於最後討論階段，將在期限內依討論結果對外說明。
立法院先前未通過行政院提出的「國防自主無人載具採購特別條例」草案，而是通過在野版本的「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」。行政院於9月3日通過的115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案中，國防預算占新台幣1457億元，項目包含濱海監偵型無人機等3項。
歷史紀錄顯示，立法院朝野黨團曾於8月20日針對無人載具條例草案進行協商，當時因對法案名稱、主管機關及經費上限等項目未達共識而宣告全案保留。

en.title: Taiwan Executive Yuan to decide on countersigning unmanned vehicle act by Sept 11
en.summary: Taiwan Executive Yuan evaluates countersigning unmanned vehicle act; decision expected by Sept 11 deadline.
body: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan has submitted the passed Enhancing Defense Self-Reliance and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Act to the Executive Yuan. The cabinet is expected to determine whether to countersign the legislation by September 11. Executive Yuan spokesperson Li Hui-chih stated that review of the act's clauses and operational execution has reached its final stage of discussion, with official details to be released within the deadline.

The Legislative Yuan previously declined to pass the Executive Yuan's drafted special procurement bill, opting instead for the opposition version. Meanwhile, the Executive Yuan approved a supplementary budget for 2026 on September 3, which allocated NT$145.7 billion to defense, including items such as coastal surveillance drones.

Historical context shows that legislative party groups held negotiations on unmanned vehicle draft bills on August 20, but failed to reach consensus regarding the governing authority, budget ceilings, and act titles.

zh.title: 川普專機起飛前突發充氣滑梯釋放致航班延誤
zh.summary: 川普前卡達專機於起飛前突發充氣滑梯釋放事件，導致前往達拉斯行程短暫受阻。
body: 根據航空媒體《Simple Flying》報導，前美國總統川普（Trump）獲卡達政府贈送的專機（該機被稱為「前卡達空軍一號」，Ex-Qatari Air Force One），在準備起飛前突然發生了充氣式緊急逃生滑梯意外釋放的事件。這起罕見的滑梯部署事件正好發生在川普登機前的關鍵時刻。
由於此起突發的緊急逃生滑梯部署事件，導致這架專機無法按原定計劃立即起飛。事件造成川普預計前往德州達拉斯（Dallas）的航程受到短暫延誤，不過目前相關報導中並未提及滑梯意外釋放的具體故障原因，亦無後續的修復進度說明。

en.title: Trump's ex-Qatari aircraft delayed by emergency slide deployment
en.summary: Trump's aircraft suffered an emergency slide deployment before takeoff, briefly delaying his Dallas flight.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, an aircraft gifted to former U.S. President Donald Trump by Qatar, described as the ex-Qatari Air Force One, suffered an unexpected deployment of its inflatable emergency evacuation slide. The incident occurred just moments before Trump was scheduled to board the aircraft for departure.

Due to the sudden deployment of the emergency slide, the aircraft's takeoff was temporarily interrupted. The occurrence resulted in a brief delay to Trump's planned flight to Dallas, though further details regarding the cause of the deployment or subsequent maintenance actions have not been disclosed.

zh.title: NTSB 初步分析顯示邁阿密 767 貨機衝出跑道前試圖復飛
zh.summary: NTSB 指 767 衝出跑道前曾加大油門復飛並隨即減至怠速
body: 2026 年 9 月 6 日，21 Air 執飛的亞馬遜航空 7598 號班機（波音 767-33A(ER)）在邁阿密國際機場 (MIA) 降落跑道 30 時衝出跑道末端，撞擊公路兩車，造成五名地面人員死亡。

國家運輸安全委員會 (NTSB) 主席 Jennifer Homendy 於 9 月 8 日舉行記者會，資深調查員 Chihoon Shin 披露飛行數據記錄器 (FDR) 顯示：著陸 30 秒前機頭與右主輪以 158 節著地，23 秒前煞車，19 秒前左主輪以 134 節著地，15 秒前釋放煞車至 120 節，隨後「Throttles increased to values consistent with go‑around thrust」，11 秒前油門減至怠速並重新煞車，7 秒前加速度變化，最後記錄速度 65 節。
Shin 並說明「No indication in the recorded data that speed brakes or thrust reversers were deployed」。
NTSB 確認將於 9 月 9 日對機長、副機長及總機長進行訪談。機長 55 歲、7,145 小時，2026 年 5 月取得 767 型別等級；副機長 37 歲、2,655 小時，2025 年 4 月 2 日取得型別等級。
駕駛艙語音記錄器保存超過 2 小時優質錄音，飛行數據記錄器含約 55 小時、逾 400 參數。起飛重量 252,182 磅 (114.4 公噸)，計劃著陸重量 231,236 磅 (104.9 公噸)。

en.title: NTSB preliminary analysis suggests Miami 767 freighter attempted go‑around before runway overrun
en.summary: NTSB says 767 applied go‑around thrust then idled before Miami overrun
body: On 6 September 2026, 21 Air Flight 7598, a Boeing 767‑33A(ER) freighter operated for Amazon Air, overran runway 30 at Miami International Airport (MIA), struck two vehicles on a public road and killed five people on the ground.

NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy held a press conference on 8 September 2026. Senior Investigator Chihoon Shin presented flight‑data recorder (FDR) data: nose and right main gear touched down at 158 kt 30 s before the end of recording; brakes applied 23 s before; left main gear touched down at 134 kt 19 s before; brakes released at 120 kt 15 s before; “Throttles increased to values consistent with go‑around thrust”; 11 s before the end throttles reduced to idle power and brakes reapplied at 117 kt; throttles remained idle with brakes applied; 7 s before the end accelerations changed at 96 kt; final recorded ground speed 65 kt.
Shin added that there was “No indication in the recorded data that speed brakes or thrust reversers were deployed”.

NTSB confirmed interviews with the chief pilot and the two pilots on board will take place on 9 September 2026. The captain is 55 years old with 7,145 flight hours and received the 767 type rating in May 2026; the first officer is 37 years old with 2,655 hours and received the type rating on 2 April 2025.

The cockpit voice recorder contains more than two hours of good‑quality audio; the FDR holds roughly 55 hours of data and over 400 parameters. Take‑off weight was 252,182 lb (114.4 t) and planned landing weight 231,236 lb (104.9 t).
